SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

2. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   C. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   B. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   C. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   C. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   B. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   B. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.

7. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   B. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

9. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   B. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   D. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

12. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   B. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   D. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat The School as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   D. Say The School never happens in Kenya.

14. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   C. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   B. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   D. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   B. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   D. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Democracy in school and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Community Leadership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain The County Governments in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Compass Direction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Location and size of the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
